description: This file defines the Layout class within the OpenCart admin module for manipulating layout records in the database. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving layout data, as well as managing associated routes and modules.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: A class to manage layout records in the OpenCart admin system, including CRUD operations for layouts, routes, and modules, and interactions with other models for layout associations.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Creates a new layout record in the database, including optional routes and modules.

methods.name: editLayout
methods.description: Updates an existing layout record and its associated routes and modules.

methods.name: deleteLayout
methods.description: Deletes a layout and all related data, including associations with categories, products, information pages, articles, and topics.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves a specific layout record by its ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of layouts with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLayouts
methods.description: Returns the total count of layout records.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a new route record associated with a layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutes
methods.description: Deletes all route records linked to a specific layout.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes route records for a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes route records for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Retrieves all route records associated with a specific layout.

methods.name: getRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves route records associated with a specific store.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module configuration to a layout.

methods.name: deleteModules
methods.description: Deletes all modules associated with a layout.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes modules by their code, including sub-codes.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all module configurations for a specific layout.
